BiblicalUsage: Shammoth the Harorite stands in David's list of mighty men, named beside Helez the Pelonite. His name is the whole of his record, and it places him among the warriors who gathered to David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Harorite's single mention is enough, because standing in David's list is standing among the mighty.
